import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long N, K;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static long[] Power = new long[65];
    static long[][] Res = new long[35][35];
    static long[][][][] S = new long[65][35][35][35];
    static long[][][][] A = new long[65][35][35][35];
    static long[][][][] P = new long[65][35][35][35];
    static long[][] Aux = new long[35][35];
    static Pair<Long, Long>[] X = new Pair[105];

    static class Pair<L, R> {
        public L first;
        public R second;
        public Pair(L first, R second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static void copy(long[][] X, long[][] Y, long n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(Y[i], 0, X[i], 0, (int) n);
        }
    }

    static void add(long[] x, long y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            x[i] += y;
            if (x[i] >= MOD) {
                x[i] -= MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    static void mul(long[][] X, long[][] Y, long[][] Z, long n, long m, long p) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < p; j++) {
                Z[i][j] = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                    Z[i][j] += (X[i][k] * Y[k][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void precalcA() {
        for (long x = 0; x < K; x++) {
            for (long i = 0; i < K + 1; i++) {
                A[0][(int) x][(int) i][(int) i] = 1;
            }
            for (long j = 0; j < K + 1; j++) {
                A[0][(int) x][(int) j][(int) x] = 1;
            }
        }
        copy(P[0][0], A[0][0], K + 1);
        copy(S[0][K - 1], A[0][K - 1], K + 1);
        for (long x = 1; x < K; x++) {
            mul(P[0][(int) (x - 1)], A[0][(int) x], P[0][(int) x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
        }
        for (long x = K - 2; x >= 0; x--) {
            mul(A[0][(int) x], S[0][(int) (x + 1)], S[0][(int) x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
        }
        long cnt = 1;
        for (long m = K; m <= N; m *= K, cnt++) {
            for (long x = 0; x < K; x++) {
                if (x > 0) {
                    copy(A[(int) cnt][(int) x], S[(int) (cnt - 1)][(int) x], K + 1);
                    long[][] AuxTemp = new long[(int) (K + 1)][(int) (K + 1)];
                    mul(A[(int) cnt][(int) x], P[(int) (cnt - 1)][(int) (x - 1)], AuxTemp, K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
                    copy(A[(int) cnt][(int) x], AuxTemp, K + 1);
                } else {
                    copy(A[(int) cnt][(int) x], S[(int) (cnt - 1)][(int) x], K + 1);
                }
            }
            copy(P[(int) cnt][0], A[(int) cnt][0], K + 1);
            copy(S[(int) cnt][K - 1], A[(int) cnt][K - 1], K + 1);
            for (long x = 1; x < K; x++) {
                mul(P[(int) cnt][(int) (x - 1)], A[(int) cnt][(int) x], P[(int) cnt][(int) x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
            }
            for (long x = K - 2; x >= 0; x--) {
                mul(A[(int) cnt][(int) x], S[(int) cnt][(int) (x + 1)], S[(int) cnt][(int) x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
            }
            if (m > N / K) break;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();

        Power[0] = 1;
        int i = 1;
        while (Power[i - 1] <= N / K) {
            Power[i] = Power[i - 1] * K;
            i++;
        }
        int ind = i;
        ind--;
        precalcA();

        long init = N;
        long last = -1;
        long count = -1;
        long ind2 = 0;
        Res[0][(int) K] = 1;

        for (int iIdx = ind; iIdx >= 0; iIdx--) {
            long powerVal = Power[iIdx];
            while (powerVal <= init) {
                long[][] ResTemp = new long[35][35];
                long[][] ResCopy = new long[35][35];
                for (int r = 0; r <= K; r++) {
                    System.arraycopy(Res[r], 0, ResCopy[r], 0, (int) (K + 1));
                }
                mul(Res, A[iIdx][(int) ind2], ResTemp, K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
                for (int r = 0; r <= K; r++) {
                    System.arraycopy(ResTemp[r], 0, Res[r], 0, (int) (K + 1));
                }
                ind2++;
                if (ind2 == K) ind2 = 0;
                init -= powerVal;
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int iIdx = 0; iIdx <= K; iIdx++) {
            ans += Res[0][iIdx];
            if (ans >= MOD) ans -= MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
